maddeler.e:
اسلنقيا (form IIIq)
# اِسْلَنْقَيَا (islanqayā) /is.lan.qa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْلَنْقَى (islanqā)
# اِسْلَنْقِيَا (islanqiyā) /is.lan.qi.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْلَنْقَى (islanqā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
